projection.formula: x = radians(lon - origin.longitude) * radius * cos(radians(origin.latitude)); z = -radians(lat - origin.latitude) * radius

sources.usage: All footprints, building level counts and context geometry

uncertainties: Building heights are an estimated 3m per storey, not measured.
OSM footprints and levels are mapped, not survey-certified.
Detailed pitched roof profiles, facades, interior walls and room polygons are not modeled.
Nearby contextual buildings/ways extend outside query bounds; UI should clip its own drawing extent.
